verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt file at developers.riskified.com that tells agents to append .md to any docs page for a markdown version. The .md URLs cited throughout the docs show those markdown pages exist across the API reference and integration guides, so an agent can be pointed at machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: any llms-full.txt or agent-specific guidance, a richer llms.txt index (its summary is just "Riskified Documentation"), and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404).
